articles.title: PEP 849: More Expressive Type Expressions
articles.description: Currently, the Python interpreter allows any expression to be used as an annotation. But their most popular usage, type annotations, are restricted to only a small subset of possible expressions. This is because type annotations need to be introspectable at runtime and many valid expressions produce values where that is not possible. This greatly limits which expressions can be assigned a meaning within the typing spec and limits the expressiveness and ease of use of type annotations.

articles.title: Quantum computing’s “dark horse” just proved it can go universal
